source.text_it: I sistemi di frenatura pneumatica di servizio e di soccorso dei veicoli pesanti prevedono almeno due serbatoi per l’aria compressa, un distributore duplex e una sezione di tubazioni indipendenti per ciascuno dei due assi

records.localized_text: Heavy-vehicle pneumatic service and emergency braking has at least two air tanks, a duplex valve and independent piping for each axle.

source.text_it: Sugli autoveicoli dotati di frenatura pneumatica, il distributore duplex serve, tra l’altro, a regolare la pressione dell’aria inviata agli elementi frenanti

records.localized_text: In pneumatic-braked vehicles, the duplex valve also regulates air pressure sent to brake components.

source.text_it: Sugli autoveicoli dotati di frenatura pneumatica, il distributore duplex invia aria alla stessa pressione agli elementi frenanti anteriori e posteriori

records.localized_text: In pneumatic-braked vehicles, the duplex valve sends air at the same pressure to front and rear brakes.

source.text_it: Sugli autoveicoli dotati di frenatura pneumatica, il distributore duplex ha due comandi: uno a pedale e l’altro a mano

records.localized_text: In pneumatic-braked vehicles, the duplex valve has two controls, one pedal and one hand-operated.

source.text_it: Sugli autoveicoli dotati di frenatura pneumatica, il distributore duplex invia aria compressa alternativamente ai due serbatoi principali

records.localized_text: In pneumatic-braked vehicles, the duplex valve alternately sends compressed air to the two main tanks.

source.text_it: Sugli autoveicoli dotati di frenatura pneumatica, il distributore duplex raddoppia la pressione dell’aria quando il veicolo è carico e sta percorrendo una discesa

records.localized_text: In pneumatic-braked vehicles, the duplex valve doubles air pressure when the vehicle is loaded and descending.

source.text_it: Sugli autoveicoli dotati di frenatura pneumatica, il distributore duplex serve a inviare differente pressione agli elementi frenanti anteriori o posteriori

records.localized_text: In pneumatic-braked vehicles, the duplex valve sends different pressures to front or rear brake components.

source.text_it: Sugli autoveicoli dotati di frenatura pneumatica, il distributore duplex non può garantire la frenatura di soccorso

records.localized_text: In pneumatic-braked vehicles, the duplex valve cannot provide emergency braking.

source.text_it: Nei veicoli dotati di frenatura ad aria compressa, il modulatore di frenata è situato tra il distributore duplex e gli elementi frenanti dell’asse posteriore

records.localized_text: In air-braked vehicles, the brake modulator is between the duplex valve and rear-axle brake components.

source.text_it: Sugli autoveicoli dotati di frenatura pneumatica, il modulatore di frenata in funzione del carico ha il compito di ridurre la pressione dell’aria inviata agli elementi frenanti dell’asse posteriore quando il veicolo non circola a pieno carico

records.localized_text: In pneumatic-braked vehicles, the load-dependent brake modulator reduces pressure sent to rear-axle brakes when the vehicle is not fully loaded.

source.text_it: Sugli autoveicoli dotati di frenatura pneumatica, il modulatore di frenata in funzione del carico ha il compito di evitare frenate a ruote bloccate

records.localized_text: In pneumatic-braked vehicles, the load-dependent brake modulator prevents braking with locked wheels.

source.text_it: Sugli autoveicoli dotati di frenatura pneumatica e sospensioni a balestra, il modulatore di frenata in funzione del carico è normalmente fissato al telaio del veicolo

records.localized_text: In vehicles with pneumatic brakes and leaf springs, the load-dependent brake modulator is normally fixed to the chassis.

source.text_it: Sugli autoveicoli dotati di frenatura pneumatica, il modulatore di frenata in funzione del carico può essere a comando pneumatico

records.localized_text: In pneumatic-braked vehicles, the load-dependent brake modulator may be pneumatically controlled.

source.text_it: Sugli autoveicoli dotati di frenatura pneumatica, il modulatore di frenata in funzione del carico viene inserito e disinserito dal conducente a mezzo di apposito pulsante

records.localized_text: In pneumatic-braked vehicles, the driver switches the load-dependent brake modulator on and off with a dedicated button.

source.text_it: Il modulatore di frenata in funzione del carico non può essere montato su veicoli dotati di ABS

records.localized_text: A load-dependent brake modulator cannot be fitted to a vehicle with ABS.

source.text_it: Sugli autoveicoli dotati di frenatura pneumatica, il modulatore di frenata in funzione del carico è normalmente fissato sull’assale delle ruote

records.localized_text: In pneumatic-braked vehicles, the load-dependent brake modulator is normally fixed to the wheel axle.

source.text_it: Sugli autoveicoli dotati di frenatura pneumatica, il modulatore di frenata in funzione del carico può essere a comando idraulico

records.localized_text: In pneumatic-braked vehicles, the load-dependent brake modulator may be hydraulically controlled.

source.text_it: Il modulatore di frenata in funzione del carico necessita di raffreddamento ad aria

records.localized_text: A load-dependent brake modulator requires air cooling.

source.text_it: L’essiccatore o l’anticongelatore si trovano tra il compressore ed i serbatoi dell’aria compressa dell’impianto di frenatura pneumatico o pneumoidraulico

records.localized_text: The dryer or antifreeze device is between the compressor and compressed-air tanks of a pneumatic or pneumatic-hydraulic brake system.

source.text_it: L’essiccatore o l’anticongelatore di cui sono dotati gli impianti di frenatura ad aria compressa, evitano che si formino cristalli di ghiaccio nelle tubazioni

records.localized_text: Air-brake dryers or antifreeze devices prevent ice crystals forming in pipes.

source.text_it: L’essiccatore o l’anticongelatore di cui sono dotati gli impianti di frenatura ad aria compressa, evitano che si formino particelle di ghiaccio nelle valvole

records.localized_text: Air-brake dryers or antifreeze devices prevent ice particles forming in valves.

source.text_it: Sugli autoveicoli dotati di frenatura pneumatica, l’essiccatore può essere raggruppato in un unico apparecchio assieme al regolatore di pressione

records.localized_text: In pneumatic-braked vehicles, the dryer may be combined with the pressure regulator in one device.

source.text_it: Sugli autoveicoli dotati di frenatura pneumatica, l’essiccatore provvede anche al filtraggio dell’aria

records.localized_text: In pneumatic-braked vehicles, the dryer also filters air.

source.text_it: L’anticongelatore impedisce il congelamento dell’aria nei serbatoi dei freni pneumatici e pneumoidraulici

records.localized_text: The antifreeze device prevents air in pneumatic and pneumatic-hydraulic brake tanks from freezing.

source.text_it: Negli impianti di frenatura ad aria compressa, l’essiccatore serve a impedire che il compressore aspiri aria troppo umida

records.localized_text: In compressed-air brakes, the dryer prevents the compressor from drawing in excessively humid air.

rows.text: In a dual-circuit system each circuit has its own reservoir and separate pipes; the common control allows some braking to remain if one circuit fails.
evidence: Utah Driver License Division, CDL manual §5.1.5, §5.1.7, §5.2, https://dld.utah.gov/cdl-manual-section-5-air-brakes/ — pedale, circuiti separati con serbatoi e tubazioni propri, e anticongelatore per ridurre il ghiaccio.

rows.text: The foot valve meters pressure to the brake circuits: pressing the pedal harder increases the braking demand.
evidence: Utah Driver License Division, CDL manual §5.1.5, §5.1.7, §5.2, https://dld.utah.gov/cdl-manual-section-5-air-brakes/ — pedale, circuiti separati con serbatoi e tubazioni propri, e anticongelatore per ridurre il ghiaccio.

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE: a simple dual valve can supply two service circuits in a coordinated way. Actuator pressure can nevertheless vary with load regulation, and some valves proportion their outlets differently; it is not always equal.
evidence: WABCO EBS3 System Description printed p.23/PDF p.25, https://www.wabco-customercentre.com/catalog/docs/8150102083.pdf — pneumatic backup valve outputs in a 1:1.5 ratio; specific counterexample, not all dual valves.
Utah CDL air-brake manual, https://dld.utah.gov/cdl-manual-section-5-air-brakes/ — common control and independent service circuits.

rows.text: Duplex refers to the two circuits controlled by the valve, not two separate controls: the service brake is operated by the pedal.
evidence: Utah Driver License Division, CDL manual §5.1.5, §5.1.7, §5.2, https://dld.utah.gov/cdl-manual-section-5-air-brakes/ — pedale, circuiti separati con serbatoi e tubazioni propri, e anticongelatore per ridurre il ghiaccio.

rows.text: The valve meters air from the reservoirs to the braking circuits; it does not fill the reservoirs alternately.
evidence: Utah Driver License Division, CDL manual §5.1.5, §5.1.7, §5.2, https://dld.utah.gov/cdl-manual-section-5-air-brakes/ — pedale, circuiti separati con serbatoi e tubazioni propri, e anticongelatore per ridurre il ghiaccio.

rows.text: The valve meters the braking requested by the pedal; it does not automatically double pressure when a loaded vehicle travels downhill.
evidence: Utah Driver License Division, CDL manual §5.1.5, §5.1.7, §5.2, https://dld.utah.gov/cdl-manual-section-5-air-brakes/ — pedale, circuiti separati con serbatoi e tubazioni propri, e anticongelatore per ridurre il ghiaccio.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE: the basic role of a dual valve is to control both circuits, not always to impose different pressures. Some valves can nevertheless proportion their outlets differently, and load regulation can change downstream pressure.
evidence: WABCO EBS3 System Description printed p.23/PDF p.25, https://www.wabco-customercentre.com/catalog/docs/8150102083.pdf — example with 1:1.5 pneumatic backup output ratio; no universal equal-pressure rule.
Utah CDL air-brake manual, https://dld.utah.gov/cdl-manual-section-5-air-brakes/ — two separate service circuits controlled by one pedal.

rows.text: Separate circuits allow the circuit still working to provide emergency braking if the other loses pressure.
evidence: Utah Driver License Division, CDL manual §5.1.5, §5.1.7, §5.2, https://dld.utah.gov/cdl-manual-section-5-air-brakes/ — pedale, circuiti separati con serbatoi e tubazioni propri, e anticongelatore per ridurre il ghiaccio.

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE. An air dryer can be placed between the compressor and reservoirs to treat the air; an antifreeze device reduces ice formation. Its position depends on the system layout.
evidence: NHTSA interpretation AIAM4461, https://www.nhtsa.gov/interpretations/aiam4461 — dryer located between compressor and reservoirs in described system.
Utah CDL air brakes https://dld.utah.gov/cdl-manual-section-5-air-brakes/ — antifreeze reduces ice formation; does not establish universal placement.

rows.text: The dryer removes moisture from the air; the antifreeze device reduces the risk of water forming ice in the circuit, including the pipes.
evidence: NHTSA, interpretation AIAM4461, https://www.nhtsa.gov/interpretations/aiam4461 — essiccatore tra compressore e serbatoi di servizio, rimozione dell’umidità.

Utah Driver License Division, CDL manual §5.1.5, §5.1.7, §5.2, https://dld.utah.gov/cdl-manual-section-5-air-brakes/ — pedale, circuiti separati con serbatoi e tubazioni propri, e anticongelatore per ridurre il ghiaccio.

rows.text: Moisture in the circuit can freeze and obstruct valves. The dryer removes it and the antifreeze device reduces the risk of ice forming.
evidence: NHTSA, interpretation AIAM4461, https://www.nhtsa.gov/interpretations/aiam4461 — essiccatore tra compressore e serbatoi di servizio, rimozione dell’umidità.

Utah Driver License Division, CDL manual §5.1.5, §5.1.7, §5.2, https://dld.utah.gov/cdl-manual-section-5-air-brakes/ — pedale, circuiti separati con serbatoi e tubazioni propri, e anticongelatore per ridurre il ghiaccio.

rows.text: The dryer can incorporate the regulator that controls supply pressure in the same unit.
evidence: ZF Air Dryers, https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64542.html — air dryer designs with integrated pressure regulation and oil separation.

rows.text: Besides removing moisture, the dryer can separate contaminants such as oil from compressed air.
evidence: ZF Air Dryers, https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_64542.html — air dryer designs with integrated pressure regulation and oil separation.

rows.text: The risk is water freezing in the circuit, not air freezing in the reservoirs; the antifreeze device reduces ice formation.
evidence: Utah Driver License Division, CDL manual §5.1.5, §5.1.7, §5.2, https://dld.utah.gov/cdl-manual-section-5-air-brakes/ — pedale, circuiti separati con serbatoi e tubazioni propri, e anticongelatore per ridurre il ghiaccio.

rows.text: The dryer treats air after compression, before the reservoirs; it does not control the humidity of the air drawn into the compressor.
evidence: NHTSA, interpretation AIAM4461, https://www.nhtsa.gov/interpretations/aiam4461 — essiccatore tra compressore e serbatoi di servizio, rimozione dell’umidità.
